component.name: Cutmary
component.summary: Run the macOS version of CapCut on Linux

description.p: Cutmary is a native launcher that installs the official macOS build of the CapCut video editor and runs it on Linux through the Rosemary compatibility runtime, without Wine, Proton or a virtual machine.
Cutmary does not include CapCut. On first launch it downloads the official installer from ByteDance onto your computer and prepares it:

ul.li: Downloads and verifies the latest official macOS installer
Extracts the app and restores its internal framework links
Removes unused Apple Silicon code, saving about 1.1 GB of disk space
Starts CapCut with tuned Rosemary settings and keeps a log for bug reports

description.p: CapCut is a trademark of ByteDance Ltd. Cutmary is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by ByteDance.
First release of the Cutmary launcher: one-click CapCut setup, launch and stop, logs viewer, and Rosemary runtime settings.
